title: Back to School
intro: [excited] Sharpen your pencils and find your seat, class is in session! Tonight it's BACK TO SCHOOL, celebrating the mentors, teachers and lessons of Disney. There will be a quiz... [laughs] it's this whole show.

art.prompt: Wide 16:9 title card: a sunlit storybook schoolhouse classroom with a chalkboard covered in doodled stars and castles, a red apple on a wooden desk, stacks of old books, a globe, a wizard's hat on a hook and a glowing lantern, golden autumn leaves outside the window, warm painterly style. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: Monsters University
categories.intro: Our film category is 2013's Monsters University! [chuckles] The only college where failing to scare is an actual failing grade.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a grand collegiate campus quad at golden hour with ivy-covered brick halls shaped like friendly monster faces, pennants in blue and gold, a scream canister trophy in a display case, autumn trees. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: At Monsters University, one-eyed Mike Wazowski starts out as rivals with this big, blue, furry legacy student.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sulley! [chuckles] James P. Sullivan, a scare legacy with zero study habits. Mike, meanwhile, read every textbook twice.

clues.clue: Voiced by Helen Mirren, this winged, centipede-like Dean of the School of Scaring strikes fear into every student.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Dean Hardscrabble! Helen Mirren gave her that perfect icy calm. One raised eyebrow and I'd drop the class.

clues.clue: Mike and Sulley compete in the Scare Games for this underdog fraternity full of misfits.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oozma Kappa, or O K for short! [laughs] Squishy, Art, Don and Terri and Terry. The ultimate group project.

clues.clue: To impress the cool kids, Mike and Sulley try to steal Archie, the scare pig mascot of this rival school.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fear Tech! [chuckles] Archie the Scare Pig led them on a chase across the whole campus. NEVER trust a pig with a cape.

clues.clue: Mike and Sulley's bickering ends with them knocking over Dean Hardscrabble's prized canister holding this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is her record-breaking scream! [gasps] It held the all-time scare record, and it shattered on the floor. Kicked out of the program, and they deserved it.

categories.title: Teacher's Pet
categories.intro: Every hero needs a mentor. [mischievously] Teacher's Pet is all about the wise, weird and sometimes GRUMPY teachers of Disney.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a mentor's training ground montage: a wooden walking stick with a gourd, a Greek training arena with broken columns, a chef's toque beside a cookbook, a woven sail on a Polynesian canoe, warm sunrise light. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: In The Lion King, this wise mandrill bonks Simba on the head with his stick to teach him a lesson about the past.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rafiki! [chuckles] The lesson: the past can hurt, but you can learn from it. The other lesson: duck.

clues.clue: In Hercules, this grumpy satyr trainer has spent his career training heroes who all turned out to be duds.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phil, short for Philoctetes! [laughs] Voiced by Danny DeVito, and the only coach who complains more than I do.

clues.clue: In Ratatouille, Remy learns to cook from a cookbook and the imaginary spirit of this late chef.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Auguste Gusteau! [excited] Anyone can cook, he said, and a rat from the countryside proved him right.

clues.clue: In Moana, this grandmother who proudly calls herself the village crazy lady helps Moana answer the call of the ocean.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Gramma Tala! She dances with the waves and returns as a glowing manta ray. BEST grandma in the Disney canon, sorry other grandmas.

clues.clue: In Big Hero 6, Hiro is inspired to apply to his brother's tech school after meeting this famous robotics professor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Professor Robert Callaghan! [sarcastic] A great mentor right up until the masked villain reveal. Read your teacher reviews, kids.

categories.title: Words of Wisdom
categories.intro: You'll hear a famous piece of Disney advice. Tell me which character said it. [whispers] Take notes, this WILL be on the test.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: an ancient candlelit library with floating glowing quotation-mark shaped wisps of light, open books, a quill and inkwell, starry night through a round window, magical blue and gold. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Who gave this advice?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dory! [excited] When life gets you down, you know what you gotta do. Just keep swimming.

clues.clue: Who gave this advice?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mufasa! [whispers] Speaking from the clouds, voiced by the legendary James Earl Jones. Goosebumps every time.

clues.clue: Who gave this advice?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yoda! [chuckles] Said to Luke on Dagobah in The Empire Strikes Back. Luke tried, and the X-wing stayed in the swamp.
clues.quote: Do. Or do not. There is no try.

clues.clue: Who gave this advice?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... the Emperor of China! He says it to Shang about Mulan. Fa Zhou has a similar line about a late blooming flower, so that was a tricky one.
clues.quote: The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all.

clues.clue: Who gave this advice?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella's Fairy Godmother! [laughs] Then she bibbidi bobbidi boos a pumpkin into a carriage. Fast miracles, honestly.
clues.quote: Even miracles take a little time.

categories.title: Field Trip!
categories.intro: Permission slips signed? Good! [excited] We're taking a field trip to the most educational corners of the Disney parks.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a yellow school bus parked before a futuristic theme park plaza with a giant silver geodesic sphere, fountains and greenhouse domes, bright blue sky, cheerful retro-futurist style. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: This giant silver geodesic sphere at the front of EPCOT takes you on a ride through the history of human communication.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spaceship Earth! [mischievously] Some people call it the giant golf ball. Those people are correct, but don't tell the Imagineers.

clues.clue: At EPCOT's The American Adventure, Benjamin Franklin co-hosts the history lesson with this famous author.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Mark Twain! Franklin and Twain, two Audio-Animatronics walking us through American history. WAY more fun than my textbook.

clues.clue: At EPCOT's The Land pavilion, this gentle boat ride floats you through real greenhouses growing crops.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Living with the Land! [excited] The veggies you see often end up on plates in EPCOT restaurants. Talk about farm to table.

clues.clue: In this EPCOT show, kids can ask questions to a surfer dude sea turtle who answers them in real time.
choices: The Seas with Nemo and Friends
Finding Nemo: The Big Blue and Beyond
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Turtle Talk with Crush! [laughs] Totally tubular, dude. Crush's Coaster is real too, but it's in Disneyland Paris.

clues.clue: Walt imagined EPCOT as a real city of the future. The letters EPCOT stand for this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Experimental Prototype Community of Tomorrow! [sighs] Walt's version had real residents. We got Figment instead, which I consider a fair trade.

categories.title: School Daze
categories.intro: Club DJ voted for School Daze: classrooms, campuses and graduations from across Disney. [laughs] No hall pass needed.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a high school hallway with red lockers, a basketball resting on a bench, graduation caps tossed in the air, a police academy badge on a desk, a broomstick leaning against a stack of mail-order lesson envelopes. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: In Inside Out, Riley has a rough first day at a new school after her family moves from Minnesota to this city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is San Francisco! [gasps] Riley also discovers the horror of broccoli pizza. Sadness took the wheel, and honestly so would mine.

clues.clue: In High School Musical, Troy Bolton and Gabriella sing their way through East High, home of these team mascots.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Wildcats! [excited] What team? Wildcats! Get your head in the game, and that song will now be stuck there all night.

clues.clue: In Zootopia, Judy Hopps graduates at the top of her class from this academy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Zootopia Police Academy! [sarcastic] First bunny cop, valedictorian, and then they assign her to parking duty. Classic.

clues.clue: In this 2006 Disney Channel spinoff, a future emperor must pass his classes at Kuzco Academy before he can take the throne.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Emperor's New School! [mischievously] Kuzco has to graduate to rule, and the principal is secretly Yzma in disguise. What could possibly go wrong?

clues.clue: In Bedknobs and Broomsticks, Eglantine Price is learning witchcraft through this kind of course run by Professor Emelius Browne.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a correspondence course! [laughs] Lessons by mail from the College of Witchcraft. The professor turned out to be a street magician. Read your reviews.
